name: OkaySend
tagline: The fast, easy, and secure way to collect documents from clients
best_for: Online coaches, Web design agencies, Professional Services
review_summary: Customers appreciate OkaySend, praising its intuitive interface, efficient document collection process, and robust security features. The platform's ability to automate client follow-ups is a standout, making onboarding a breeze. Recent updates have introduced recurring request automation and integrated e-signatures directly into document requests, enhancing its functionality. While some users have expressed interest in additional features like conditional logic and a client portal, these are not major concerns. Overall, with a stellar rating of 4.9 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, OkaySend is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to streamline their document collection. Don't hesitate to give it a try!
